text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, you are living in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see but do not see, who have ears to hear but do not hear;
text_cn: “人子，你是住在叛逆的家族中，他们有眼，却视而不见；有耳，却听而不闻；因为他们是叛逆的家族。

text_en: for they are a rebellious house. Therefore, mortal, prepare for yourself an exile’s baggage, and go into exile by day in their sight; you shall go like an exile from your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
text_cn: 人子，你要白天在他们眼前准备充军的行囊，并在他们眼前从一地迁移到另一地；他们或者能看清自己是叛逆的家族。

text_en: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for exile; and you shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as those do who go into exile.
text_cn: 你白天在他们眼前把行囊搬出，像搬出充军的行囊；傍晚在他们眼前出发，像充军者出发。

text_en: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry the baggage through it.
text_cn: 你还要在他们眼前在墙上穿一个洞，由那里走过去。

text_en: In their sight you shall lift the baggage on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark; you shall cover your face, so that you may not see the land; for I have made you a sign for the house of Israel.
text_cn: 你当着他们的面，把行囊背在肩上，天黑时出发，并且蒙着脸，看不到地面：因为我要使你作为以色列家族的一个预兆。”

text_en: I did just as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for exile, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my own hands; I brought it out in the dark, carrying it on my shoulder in their sight.
text_cn: 我遂遵命行了：白天我把行囊搬出，有如充军的行囊，傍晚用手在墙上穿了一个洞；到天黑时，当着他们的面，把行囊背在肩上出发。

text_en: In the morning the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 到了早晨，上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, “What are you doing? ”
text_cn: “人子，以色列家族，那叛逆的家族不是问你说：你在作什么？”

text_en: Say to them, “Thus says the Lord God : This oracle concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel in it. ”
text_cn: 你要回答他们说：吾主上主这样说：这神谕是有关耶路撒冷的君王和城中的以色列全家族。

text_en: Say, “I am a sign for you: as I have done, so shall it be done to them; they shall go into exile, into captivity. ”
text_cn: 并且说：我为你们是一个预兆：像我所行过的，也要实现在他们身上：他们要被掳充军异地。

text_en: And the prince who is among them shall lift his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and shall go out; he shall dig through the wall and carry it through; he shall cover his face, so that he may not see the land with his eyes.
text_cn: 君王在他们当中肩上背着重担，在黑夜出发，在墙上要穿一洞，为叫他出去；他要蒙着脸，以致他再不能亲眼看见这地方。

text_en: I will spread my net over him, and he shall be caught in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, yet he shall not see it; and he shall die there.
text_cn: 我要在他面前设下罗网，他必要陷在我的罗网中而被捉住；然后我领他到加色丁人的地方巴比伦，但他一无所见，就死在那里。

text_en: I will scatter to every wind all who are around him, his helpers and all his troops; and I will unsheathe the sword behind them.
text_cn: 我还要把他左右的护卫，以及一切军队，分散到四方，并拔出剑来追赶他们。

text_en: And they shall know that I am the Lord , when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
text_cn: 当我把他们驱散到异民中，把他们分散到各国时，他们必承认我是上主。

text_en: But I will let a few of them escape from the sword, from famine and pestilence, so that they may tell of all their abominations among the nations where they go; then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 但我在他们中仍保留少数的人，免受刀兵、饥荒和瘟疫之害，为叫他们给他们所到之地的异民，讲述自己的丑恶之事，使那些人也认识我是上主。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness;
text_cn: “人子，你要战战兢兢地吃饭，怀着颤栗和惶恐喝水。

text_en: and say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord God concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with fearfulness, and drink their water in dismay, because their land shall be stripped of all it contains, on account of the violence of all those who live in it.
text_cn: 你应向此地的人民宣讲说：吾主上主论及耶路撒冷的居民和以色列地域这样说：他们要惶恐地吃饭，惊惧地喝水，为了那里的居民所行的残暴，那地方要被洗劫，变为荒芜之地。

text_en: The inhabited cities shall be laid waste, and the land shall become a desolation; and you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 人烟稠密的城市要变为旷野，那地方必变为沙漠：如此，你们必承认我是上主。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, what is this proverb of yours about the land of Israel, which says, “The days are prolonged, and every vision comes to nothing”?
text_cn: “人子，在以色列地域，有人说：日期迟延了，异象落空了。这流言是什么意思？

text_en: Tell them therefore, “Thus says the Lord God : I will put an end to this proverb, and they shall use it no more as a proverb in Israel. ” But say to them, The days are near, and the fulfillment of every vision.
text_cn: 为此你应向他们说：吾主上主这样说：我必使这流言停止，以色列必不再说这流言；你该向他们说：日期近了，所有的异象必要实现。

text_en: For there shall no longer be any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.
text_cn: 在以色列家族内，决不再有虚伪的异象和欺诈的预言。

text_en: But I the Lord will speak the word that I speak, and it will be fulfilled. It will no longer be delayed; but in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak the word and fulfill it, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 因为是我上主讲话，我讲的话必要实现，不再迟延。叛逆的家族！我说的话必在你们这一代实现 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, the house of Israel is saying, “The vision that he sees is for many years ahead; he prophesies for distant times. ”
text_cn: “人子，以色列家族说：这人所见的异象是指遥远的来日；他说的预言，是指遥远的时期。

text_en: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord God : None of my words will be delayed any longer, but the word that I speak will be fulfilled, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 为此你要向他们说：吾主上主这样说：我说的一切话，不再迟延；我所说的话，必要实现 —— 吾主上主的断语。”
